scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0082; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: ‘This is my family’ and ‘My family is here’ are natural short A1 family statements.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: خانواده directly matches the bounded family sense in both turns.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One concrete noun target is practiced in two familiar be-patterns.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast family with familiar people/place nouns without ambiguity.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: A family-photo conversation naturally motivates both learner utterances.

difficultyFit.evidence: Utterances are short and early-A1 appropriate.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: family repeats across listening, recognition, transfer and hidden retrieval.

transferQuality.evidence: The learner moves from identifying family in a photo to stating presence.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, turns and tasks align with the same bounded outcome.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; confidence is limited to model/editor review.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded A1 family sense is reviewed.
Audio prosody is not evaluated at this stage.
resolvedFindings: The returning pair is spaced from its immediately previous appearance and the learner role is rotated.
